name: Crab
summary: A tucked ball with crossed ankles: roll back, switch the cross, then roll forward until the top of the head touches the mat.
steps: Sit in a tuck with the ankles crossed, holding the feet.
Roll back to the shoulder blades and switch the cross of the legs.
Roll up and forward, lifting the hips, until the crown of the head rests lightly on the mat.
Roll back again without pushing off the head.

layers.title: Roll back and up to balance
layers.text: No roll onto the head yet.

layers.title: Add the switch
layers.text: Change the cross at the back of the roll.

layers.title: Forward to the head
layers.text: The lightest touch, weight in the legs.

cautions.note: Deep knee bend with crossed ankles. Use Seal instead.

cues:
The abdominals lift you forward, not momentum.
No weight drops onto the head.
Stay round the whole way.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Seal
variations.note: Same roll without going onto the head.
